{"metadata":{"description":"Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain (no key) + pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns.","id":"gh:1333446374","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-vision-router","slug":"ysr666/dsh-vision-router","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","multimodal","vision"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain (no key) + pixel-level vision"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"dsh-vision-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Turn vision on when you need it — eyes for text-only agents on DeepSeek Harness. Free out of the box"},{"id":"p3s2","text":", no key, no Python, one command."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek keeps thinking; the built-in free vision chain and fourteen deep tools do the seeing. When "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"an image matters, enable the composer’s “👁 Vision” control and use image turns like ordinary tool-ca"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"lling turns — grounded, measurable, repeatable."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DeepGuard badge links to a historical v2.0.1 audit; it does not certify current releases."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!CAUTION]
> **Data leaves your machine by default.** When a cloud vision model is used, Vision Ro"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"uter sends the image (or a derived crop), the vision prompt and related request metadata to that pro"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"vider. A fresh install has an anonymous OVHcloud vision fallback enabled, so "free" and "no key" do "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"**not** mean offline. Do not use the cloud chain for confidential, regulated or classified material."},{"id":"p7s5","text":" See Data flow and strict local-only use."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **v3.2.0-rc.0 optional Host-retirement prerelease track (not stable):** Requires DSH "},{"id":"p8s2","text":">=0.2.1-rc.5 and Node >=24.9.0, keeps Connection authentication/trustedHosts owned by DSH and retain"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"s only the minimal webServer startup-order patch. **Do not upgrade a working profile solely to try t"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"his RC.** First use the read-only upgrade preflight and separately verify historical Session compati"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"bility. The RC is installable **only if** npm `next` and a matching immutable GitHub prerelease have"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" both been published; npm `latest` remains the stable channel. See v3.2.0-rc.0 release notes."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Start here"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**1. Install in an existing DSH Web profile:**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**2. Keep your usual chat model** and click **👁 Vision** beside the composer; check for **👁 Vision ✓"},{"id":"p12s2","text":". Keep your usual chat model** and click **👁 Vision** beside the composer; check for **👁 Vision ✓**."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**3. Paste or upload an image** and ask the agent what to inspect. The built-in keyless cloud fallba"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ck is available out of the box."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Using Desktop? Change `--profile web` to `--profile desktop` and reload the app. For Oh-DSH and manu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"al setups, follow the complete installation guide."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Full quick start · What it can do · Data flow and local-only use"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The vision model is **only the eyes**; DeepSeek is **always the brain**. An image turn is never hija"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"cked by a one-shot vision answer — the agent drives the tools itself and can keep operating on the i"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"mage across as many steps as the task needs."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Most DSH vision plugins bridge images to DeepSeek as *text descriptions* — lossy, one-shot, and blin"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"d to pixels. This plugin keeps the **Host-canonical image pixels on the vision model's side** and De"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"epSeek on the reasoning side, and makes looking at an image an **ordinary tool call**:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **One command install.** The package ships its own composition patch (`dsh.bundle.patch`): `dsh pl"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ugin add` wires the row, the admission wrapper and the attachment limits automatically — zero manual"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" file edits. Taking over the official DeepSeek route is an optional setting (stealth mode, off by de"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"fault).
- **Free by default.** Vision tools end with a four-model OVHcloud anonymous fallback: no ac"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"count, no key, 2 requests/minute per IP per model, roughly 8 RPM in theory across independent bucket"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"s. User-provided vision models run first.
- **No Python.** The whole pipeline — downscale, grounding"},{"id":"p20s7","text":", crop, pixel diff, palette, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, HTML screenshot — runs on sharp / potrace / tes"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"seract / system Chrome.
- **Continuous multi-step image work.** An image turn is a text turn that ca"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"lls tools: `vision_ground` → `vision_crop` → `vision_describe` → `vision_pixel_diff` → fix → screens"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"hot again. The agent keeps iterating until the work is done.
- **DeepSeek stays the brain.** Text tu"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"rns are untouched in model, cost and context. The vision model is only the eyes, called on demand; a"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"nswers are cached by image content.
- **Transparent to the user.** Uploaded images keep rendering as"},{"id":"p20s13","text":" images in the conversation UI; the rewrite that points the model at the vision tools happens only i"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"nside the model call, never in the session log."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness Web profile. Normal installs can use `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh ...`; source checkouts"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" use `pnpm dsh ...`. A bare `dsh ...` command only works when the CLI is already on your shell `PATH"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"`.
- **DSH Host policy (unreleased DVR 3.2 candidate):** Minimum DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; currently recommend"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ed DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. DSH 0.1.x, 0.2.0 and earlier 0.2.1 prereleases are retired. DSH owns native Conne"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ction authentication, routing and trustedHosts. Older sessions, attachments and Settings data remain"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" readable. See new Host support window and retirement plan.
- Node.js >=24.9.0 (Host side; Node 22 i"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"s retired).
- No API key for the default free chain; a credential reference (`apiKeyEnv`) only for p"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"aid `httpProviders`.
- Chrome / Chromium / Edge is needed only for `vision_html_screenshot`; every o"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ther tool works without a browser.
- Desktop capture is opt-in. Windows and macOS use OS-provided ca"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"pture facilities; Linux needs ImageMagick `import` or `scrot` and a capturable desktop session (Wayl"},{"id":"p22s11","text":"and support depends on the environment).
- Tesseract is optional. `vision_ocr` defaults to `ocrEngin"},{"id":"p22s12","text":"e: auto` (local Tesseract first, vision fallback), and Settings → Advanced → **Default OCR engine** "},{"id":"p22s13","text":"can force Tesseract-only or vision-model-only behavior without uninstalling Tesseract. An explicit p"},{"id":"p22s14","text":"er-call `engine=tesseract|vision` always overrides the default."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Image text is **untrusted evidence**: descriptions, OCR output and the auto-mount note all tell th"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"e agent never to execute instructions found inside images.
- Tool inputs resolve through `ctx.fs` (s"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"andbox-aware); vision uploads never send anything but the selected image and the question.
- Artifac"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ts write only under `<workspace>/.dsh-vision-router/artifacts`; results return absolute paths and by"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"te counts.
- Secrets never travel: `apiKeyEnv` names a DSH credential reference; the value is resolv"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ed per call and never logged.
- The settings write path goes through the settings service (schema-va"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"lidated, revision-checked) — a stale or invalid save is rejected, not partially applied."}],"truncated":true}
